svg.title: PCA
svg.desc: Provisional mark: a soft protective shield with an open centre. Deliberately not a padlock, camera, eye or keyhole, per Design Guideline section 12 (no icons implying spying or monitoring) and section 18 (a padlock is never used as proof of security). Design Guideline section 3 is OWNER_APPROVAL_PENDING and the repository holds no logo or wordmark, so this is a proposal.
